_about: DFD clips that dfd_clips() leaves out or files under another actor. Found 2026-10-24 by face-matching (OpenCV SFace) the tracked face of every DFD video against each actor's own single-person scenes, at 1 frame/s, and by cross-correlating the cached colour traces. The two walking scenes are the SAME footage filed under both partners (correlation 1.000, zero offset); DFD has no fakes for them, so the tracker had no swap target and follows the same face in both copies, giving identical windows under two subjects. One copy of each pair is kept, under the person it actually tracks; footage whose tracker switches between the two people mid-video is dropped.
